dct_description_sm: This study evaluates the environmental impacts of biodegradable PBAT liners as an alternative to conventional HDPE liners for livestock carcass transport using a cradle-to-grave life cycle assessment. The results highlight the importance of production scale, transportation, and end-of-life management in determining the overall sustainability of biodegradable plastics.
